title: Category sitemap compatibility with the existing Supabase schema
summary: Read-only checks identified a missing optional updated_at column on categories; preserve category indexing without a schema change.

changes.detail: Retry sitemap reads without updated_at only for the specific missing-column error; omit lastmod rather than invent dates.
Regression checks for legacy category schemas and stale editor refresh; all-product metadata uniqueness checks and failure exit status.
Verifier accepts crawlable category navigation for products with no similar cards and handles unknown stock.

validation.name: Read-only discovery
validation.detail: 390 local HTTP checks found category sitemap 503 and one price mismatch. Live categories.updated_at query returned PostgreSQL 42703. No database changes.

validation.name: Editor browser regression
validation.detail: Production UI fixtures passed at 375, 768 and 1440 pixels, including stale refresh/reload, generation, approval, reset, bulk and history.
